## What changes

Describe the behavior change in one or two paragraphs.

## Why

Link the issue (e.g. Fixes #123) or explain the motivation.

## Testing

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests in `test/`

## Checklist

- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes introduced (plain hyphens only)

- [ ] Backward compatible, or migration path documented
